decision_rules_proposed: Both models improve similarly while B8 remains worse: attribute gain to training target choice and simplify DTFM claim
B8 stable same-loss benefit across seeds with acceptable guardrails: retain the specific single-scale implementation contribution
Only lambda2 supports B8 benefit: describe training-protocol-conditional contribution
Ranking improves but amplitude/probability quality worsens: disclose tradeoff and evaluate fixed guardrails
Repeated controlled lack of useful benefit: simplify or remove from core contribution, no endless candidate search
One-seed negative result does not prove universal ineffectiveness
DOTE_next_condition: Only if further DOTE attribution has decision value, consider REAL/ZERO x loss using matched saved E0 and new corresponding cells, preserving capacity/mask limits. Direction controls come after predictive benefit, no automatic launch.

fixed-budget one-seed screening is developmental and may be seed sensitive
module comparison includes its defined initialization and optimization protocol, not a pure physical mechanism
